metadata.name: Thatcherism
metadata.description: The political-economic doctrine developed by the Thatcher/Joseph movement, with privatisation, market competition, legal order and national sovereignty. Historical government conduct is contextual evidence rather than an automatic doctrinal position.
metadata.scope: The political-economic doctrine developed by the Thatcher/Joseph movement, with privatisation, market competition, legal order and national sovereignty. Historical government conduct is contextual evidence rather than an automatic doctrinal position. Revision2 is an incomplete evidence audit of this specified school. Unsupported modern applications and empirical causal comparisons are null/unknown. Neither agreement nor neutrality is inferred from silence. Historical or programme sources are not a complete contemporary incumbent-government record.
metadata.phrase: A society based on private ownership, competitive enterprise, personal responsibility and a state maintaining law and national defence.
